WITH SUB_TOTAL AS ( SELECT ST.stock_type , SUM(CASE WHEN (SD.staff_no IS NOT NULL) AND (SD.return_date IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lending_count -- 貸出備品の数 , SUM(CASE WHEN SD.staff_no IS NULL AND SD.return_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stock_count -- 在庫備品の数 , SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), SD.confirmed_date) > 365 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unknown_count -- 不明備品の数 FROM (SELECT stock_type FROM stock_type_master WHERE 1 = 1 AND del = FALSE) ST INNER JOIN stock_master SM ON ST.stock_type = SM.stock_type AND SM.del = FALSE INNER JOIN stock_data SD ON SM.stock_code = SD.stock_code AND SD.del = FALSE WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY ST.stock_type )
SELECT ST.id , ST.name AS itemName , S.lending_count AS loanCount , S.stock_count AS returnCount , S.unknown_count AS unknownCount , S.lending_count + S.stock_count AS totalCount FROM stock_type_master ST INNER JOIN SUB_TOTAL S ON ST.stock_type = S.stock_type WHERE 1 = 1 ORDER BY ST.stock_type
SELECT , EV.名称 AS itemName , EV.貸出 AS loanCount , EV.在庫 AS returnCount , EV.不明 AS unknownCount , EV.合計 AS totalCount FROM equip_list_view EV WHERE 1 = 1
